lines.text: DeepSeek dropped an agent harness three weeks ago.
Two hundred and eleven thousand stars already.
Everything inside it is a plugin, so thirteen thousand people started building for it.
I went looking for the thing nobody had made yet.
Every voice plugin in there wants an API key.
So I built one that does not.
Give it a few lines, and it renders a finished reel.
Free voice, real captions, running on your own laptop.
Comment reels, and it lands in your DMs.
